hints.text: The $x$-axis is the mirror line, so the point moves straight up or down. Think about which coordinate that changes.
Keep the $x$-coordinate $5$ the same. The point is $2$ units below the $x$-axis, so its image is $2$ units above: change $y = -2$ to its opposite.
The opposite of $-2$ is $2$, so the new point is $(5, 2)$.

explanation: Reflecting over the $x$-axis moves a point straight up or down, so the $x$-coordinate stays the same.
The $y$-coordinate changes to its opposite, because the image is the same distance from the axis on the other side.
For this point, $x$ stays $5$ and the value $y = -2$ becomes $2$.
So the reflected point has coordinates $(5, 2)$.
